$comment: Thresholds of pipeline:line-names for cba (R3.4 step 1), read through lib/ign-match.ts classify(). COPIED from regions/nqn/ign.config.json on 2026-10-11 and PROVISIONAL for cba: they have not been calibrated on cba data. Only bufferM, high, medium and low are used by pipeline:line-names (the coverage buffer itself comes from lines.config.json: bufferM below largeMinStrahler, bufferLargeM from it up); the other keys (line, river*, minDetailPieceM, water) are kept so the file has the nqn shape for the later consumers (named, ign-streams, export). coverage = fraction of a reach within the buffer of the lines carrying one name; margin = coverage of the best name minus the runner-up. namesFrom (R3.4 step 3) says which step writes the line names that pipeline:named, pipeline:ign-streams and pipeline:export read: "line-names" = data/work/cba/line-names/ (APRHI inside the province, IGN outside); absent or "ign-match" = data/work/<region>/ign-match/ (nqn). line.minCoverage and line.maxGap are now used by pipeline:named and pipeline:ign-streams on the line-names coverage and are as provisional as the other copied values. mapLines (R3.7): what pipeline:export writes to tiles/reaches.geojson, the map's river lines: "pieces" = the display line pieces of pipeline:lines (APRHI inside the province, IGN outside) clipped out of lakes by pipeline:lakes (lakes/line_geom.parquet); absent or "reaches" = the HydroRIVERS reaches (nqn). expectedSeaOutlets (R3.4 step 3): number of approved rivers that flow into no other approved river, checked by pipeline:named (default 1, nqn's single outlet). 9 is the count measured on 2026-10-12 with the 13 approved rivers (Carcarañá to the Paraná; Quinto, Dulce, Primero, Segundo, Jesús María, Conlara, Cruz del Eje and Pichanas end in HydroRIVERS outlets or endorheic sinks): it guards against a river silently changing outlet, it is not a claim that they reach the sea.
